Sandbox_Bartering.EnableSkill_tooltip: If disabled, players receive the full benefits of max Bartering level without leveling the skill.
Sandbox_Bartering.EnableRelationships_to: If enabled, trading with barterers builds relationship. Each star gives +1 percent value to your traded items.
Sandbox_Bartering.CallRelationshipStars_: Relationship stars needed with a barterer before you can call them or receive their sale calls. Only used when relationships are enabled.
Sandbox_Bartering.HireRelationshipStars_: Relationship stars needed with a barterer before you can hire them. Only used when relationships are enabled.
Sandbox_Bartering.StockSlot1Relationship: Relationship stars for first bonus stock slot
Relationship stars needed to unlock the first extra stock slot.
Sandbox_Bartering.StockSlot2Relationship: Relationship stars for second bonus stock slot
Relationship stars needed to unlock the second extra stock slot.
Sandbox_Bartering.AllowHiring_tooltip: If enabled, players can hire barterers to follow them. The relationship stars needed are set by 'Relationship stars to hire'.
Sandbox_Bartering.HireCostPerHour: Hire cost per in-game hour (trade value)
Sandbox_Bartering.HireCostPerHour_toolti: Trade value cost per in-game hour of barterer hire time.
Sandbox_Bartering.BarterValueBonusPerLev: Additional barter value added for each Bartering level.
Sandbox_Bartering.BarterRefreshHours_too: Number of in-game hours between barterer stock refreshes.
Sandbox_Bartering.SaleDays_tooltip: If enabled, each barterer holds a weekly sale day with discounted items and radios players about it.
Sandbox_Bartering.RealTimeTravelMultipli: Multiplies real-time seconds required for a barterer to reach you. 1.00 uses the default travel speed.
Sandbox_Bartering.RespawnAfterPlayerKill: If disabled, a barterer killed by a player stays dead and will not respawn.
Sandbox_Bartering.RespawnAfterZombieKill: If disabled, a barterer killed by zombies stays dead and will not respawn.
Sandbox_Bartering.RespawnHours_tooltip: Number of in-game hours before a dead barterer is replaced when respawn is enabled.
Sandbox_Bartering.QuestCooldownDays_tool: Number of in-game days after completing a retrieval quest before that barterer offers another one.
Sandbox_Bartering.QuestTimeLimitDays_too: In-game days to turn a retrieval quest in before the barterer gives up on it. 0 disables the limit.
Sandbox_Bartering.RequireMeetingBeforeCa: If enabled, a player must meet a barterer in person before they can call them over the radio.
Sandbox_Bartering.ResetRelationshipOnDea: If enabled, a player's relationship stars with every barterer are lost when they die. If disabled, their next character keeps them.
Sandbox_Bartering.ResetMetOnDeath_toolti: If enabled, a player must meet barterers again after dying. If disabled, their next character keeps the barterers they have met.
Sandbox_Bartering.ArriveAtCallLocation_t: Choose whether called barterers arrive at the caller or at the location where the call was made, adds option to update location in walky talky.
Sandbox_Bartering.Barterer1CallStartHour: Earliest hour Barterer 1 accepts radio calls.
Sandbox_Bartering.Barterer1CallEndHour_t: Latest hour Barterer 1 accepts radio calls.
Sandbox_Bartering.Barterer2CallStartHour: Earliest hour Barterer 2 accepts radio calls.
Sandbox_Bartering.Barterer2CallEndHour_t: Latest hour Barterer 2 accepts radio calls.
Sandbox_Bartering.Barterer3CallStartHour: Earliest hour Barterer 3 accepts radio calls.
Sandbox_Bartering.Barterer3CallEndHour_t: Latest hour Barterer 3 accepts radio calls.
Sandbox_Bartering.Barterer4CallStartHour: Earliest hour Barterer 4 accepts radio calls.
Sandbox_Bartering.Barterer4CallEndHour_t: Latest hour Barterer 4 accepts radio calls.
Sandbox_Bartering.ShoveKnockdownChance_t: Chance that a shove knocks a barterer to the ground.
Sandbox_Bartering.LogBartererSounds_tool: Prints every sound and zombie-attracting noise a barterer makes to the console log.
Sandbox_Bartering.DebugMode_tooltip: Enables developer debug options in context menus and the barter UI.
